close_reason: Fixed: fetched_count now only increments on Ok(()); truncation guard uses visited.len(); new test backfill_count_excludes_duplicate_entries confirms correct behaviour.
description: In backfill.rs line 159, fetched_count is incremented AFTER both Ok(()) and DuplicateEntry arms. When a concurrent writer has already inserted the entry (DuplicateEntry), we still count it as fetched. The returned count will be inflated by the number of concurrent collisions. The comment on line 155 says 'treat as idempotent success' but does not exclude it from the count. — Misreported backfill count confuses callers that use the return value for progress tracking or truncation decisions.
title: backfill: fetched_count wrong when DuplicateEntry
